items.summary: In ConvertX before 0.19.0, converters/calibre.ts does not block .recipe/.downloaded_recipe files and passes them to Calibre's ebook-convert, enabling execution of arbitrary code embedded in recipe files. Disclosed Oct 3; no public exploit or KEV listing yet.

Cisco IOS XE command/OS/argument-injection flaw surfaced by Cisco's own AI-assisted internal security review, leading a seven-CVE hardening release across the 16.6.2–26.1.3 train (fixed in 17.9.10, 17.12.8, 17.15.6, 17.18.4/a, 26.1.2). There is no workaround — upgrading is the only fix.

Rejetto HTTP File Server 3.0.0–3.2.0 derives its session-cookie signing key from the non-cryptographic Math.random() generator and leaks generator outputs, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution (fixed in 3.2.1). VulnCheck observed exploitation in the wild starting Oct 1, within 24h of the Horizon3 disclosure.

Incorrect authorization in FileSystem in Google Chrome on Windows before 154.0.8037.97 lets a remote attacker leveraging social engineering potentially execute arbitrary code. Update Chrome immediately.

OS command injection in the Studio Space startup validation script in Amazon SageMaker Distribution 2.x before 2.14.12, 3.x before 3.9.12, 4.0.x before 4.0.11 and 4.1.x before 4.1.x fix lines. Disclosed Oct 2; patch the distribution before launching shared Studio spaces.
